A shipment arrives. An invoice goes out. Then a deduction appears. A shortage, a pricing discrepancy, a compliance charge. Somewhere between a retailer notice and a folder of documents, revenue gets left behind.

Recovering it takes evidence, attention, and time your team doesn’t have to spare.

We’re building Mozart to bring it all together.

Mozart turns deduction notices and supporting documents into clear, evidence-backed disputes. It helps your team understand what happened, what’s missing, and what to do next—with a human in control of the final decision.

05 / A FEW MORE NOTES

Questions.
Clear answers.

The short answers are here.
Let’s talk through the rest.

Talk to our team ↗
What does Mozart do?

Mozart automates deduction recovery, from finding disputes to updating your books. Our agents log in to your retailer portals, gather evidence, and submit appeals with your approval. Connected accounting and ERP systems keep every recovery reconciled, so your team spends less time chasing deductions.

What do I need to get started?

We’ll help you connect the places where your files and records already live—from shared folders and databases to your accounting or ERP system—and set up retailer access. You choose what Mozart can access, so there’s less to gather and upload.

Does Mozart connect to my accounting or ERP system?

Mozart brings your accounting, ERP, and retailer records together to match deductions, track disputes, and reconcile recoveries. Tell us what your team uses—we’ll confirm the right connections and help you get set up. You stay in control of access and accounting changes.

Does Mozart submit disputes automatically?

Yes—with your approval. Mozart handles the full process: finding deductions, gathering evidence, submitting appeals, following up, and reconciling recoveries in your accounting system. Your team simply says yes or no to the proposed actions. We take care of the rest.

How is my data used?

Your records are used to deliver the service, including reconciliation, evidence preparation, and support. Relevant documents may be processed by OCR and AI providers. Read our Privacy Policy for details on sharing, retention, and your choices. Read the Privacy Policy ↗

How much does it cost?

Pricing and any contingency fee are agreed before paid work begins. Your service agreement defines the rate and which recoveries are billable. Get in touch to discuss your deduction volume and workflow.
